traceability.notes: No matching bootstrap PDF-list record found (likely a certificate added/renamed after the bootstrap PDF was issued); no renewal history or validation-scope text available yet. Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Table 6 (page 5) presents results by category with subcategories (a, b, c) and a 'Total' row per category; I recorded only the category-level Total rows (Meat products, Egg products, Seafood products, Multi-component foods or meal component products), excluding subcategory rows and the overall 'Total (All categories)' row, per instructions. The report also contains a separate interlaboratory study (section 4) with its own sensitivity/relative trueness/false positive ratio values (SEalt 96.2%, SEref 96.2%, RT 94.9%, FPR 0.96%) based on ground beef samples only across 15 labs - this is a reproducibility study, not the primary per-category method comparison, so it was not included in the main table. RLOD data (section 3.2) and inclusivity/exclusivity data (section 3.3) were also not included as they are not part of the requested method-comparison sensitivity/trueness/FPR table.
